Golden pairs generated by the JVM emitter (`scripts/gen-parity-golden.clj`) for the nbb parity test
(`test/nbb/parity.cljs`). `<name>.kir.edn` is the KIR fixture exported by the JVM test namespace,
`<name>.mjs` the module the JVM emitted for it; `f64.edn` pairs raw f64 bits with `Double.toString`.
Regenerate after any emitter change: `clojure -M:golden`.
